title: Penguin finale (Dark Crystal + Fennimore on the moon) plays the generic 'boss' song, not boss_penguin
repro: story.json penguins ch5 beat p5_spire effects: boss_card 'dark_crystal' first starts boss_track('dark_crystal') = boss_penguin (Story._apply order: boss_card then music), then fx 'music':'boss' immediately replaces it. DangerMusic.tick keeps it because 'boss' is in BOSS_TRACKS and tier==4. Same pattern in gangsters ch5 beat (president: boss_gang overridden by 'boss'). CONFIRMED by probe: after boss_card wanted=boss_penguin, after the story fx wanted=boss, held.
fix: Remove "music": "boss" from penguins/4/beats/0 and gangsters/4/beats/5 effects in data/story.json (boss_card already starts the right theme), or set it to boss_penguin / boss_gang. Add a story_test assert that a beat with boss_card has no music effect.

title: Finale victory 'meadow' song on the moon lasts ~3 s before DangerMusic swaps back to 'moon'
repro: p5_win effects 'music':'meadow' on the moon scene. DangerMusic.tick (tier 0, AREA_EVERY 3 s) re-asks area_track() = 'moon' and crossfades away. Any story fx music that is not a boss track has the same 3-second life.
fix: Play a victory sting instead (Music.sfx j_victory / DangerMusic.boss_ended sting) and let area_track run; or give story music a hold (e.g. DangerMusic.hold_until(track) honoured while Music.wanted()==that track until map change).

title: Countryside song (brief: 'countryside (gangster arc)', Americana harmonica) plays in the penguin arc on countryside and on the community farm
repro: Probe (penguin arc): countryside day=countryside, community_farm day/night/rain/festival=countryside (community_farm.gd:65 music_track = "countryside"; regions.json countryside music). AUDIO-PLAN B14 marks countryside as the gangster arc's song.
fix: In area_track: penguin arc countryside -> 'orchard' or 'meadow' (or a new penguin countryside take); community_farm -> 'farm'/'farm_fall' by season or 'town' (it is the town's west road), gangster keeps countryside.
audio_needed: optional: a pastoral penguin-arc countryside song

title: Community farm has no night/rain/festival variants: walking town -> community farm at 11pm jumps from 'night' to the daytime countryside song
repro: Probe: town nt=night, community_farm nt=countryside, wet=countryside. community_farm is not in NIGHT_OK.
fix: Add 'community_farm' to GameMap.NIGHT_OK (night + rain then follow automatically and the night song continues across the town exit without restarting).

title: Penguin sanctuary song (D5 'sanctuary') is never played anywhere
repro: AREA_MUSIC has 'sanctuary':'sanctuary' but no scene has id 'sanctuary'; no data or script plays it. The Merkitty Pool / Burrow / Shrine sit on the farm (Sanctuary system), which plays farm/farm_fall/winter. grep finds no other caller.
fix: Use it: e.g. crystal_meadow at night (instead of cattopia all night), or farm by day in the penguin arc when the player stands near the pool/shrine (area_track check on Sanctuary building distance), or inside the burrow if it has an interior. Remove the dead AREA_MUSIC key.

title: Festival song plays 24 h in town on festival day (3am, 6am, after the 9-18 festival), overriding night and rain
repro: area_track returns 'festival' for town whenever festival_today()!='' before the night check. Shops/rec treat the festival as 9:00-18:00; town ambience crowd runs 8:00-23:00 (ambience.gd:187).
fix: Only return 'festival' when 8*60 <= time < 23*60 (match Ambience); otherwise fall through to night/rain/town.

title: 20 battlefields share three songs (battle/battle_siege/battle_escort) in the penguin arc; themed fields (frostfield, kelp_beds, reef_shallows, cloud_stair, jungle_grove, station_deck...) sound identical
repro: Probe: every bf_* day/night = battle (mode variants only with a live Battle). AUDIO-PLAN line 62 already notes it. Gangster arc gets _gang variants; penguins get no arc-flavoured battle song.
fix: Add penguin battle variants (battle_penguin, battle_siege_penguin) and/or per-theme family songs (ice, sea, sky, jungle) picked from bf_themes FIELDS ('music' key) in area_track; fall back to battle.
audio_needed: 2-4 new battle songs: penguin-arc march (theme melody), sea/ice/sky flavoured variants

title: Mega areas reuse other places' songs: frost_summit=colony_ice, frost_caverns=mine_deep, hollow_deeps=hollow_heart, sky_reaches=sky, two of four Gloamwood/Windward/Frostpeak areas share one track
repro: Probe penguin arc: frost_summit colony_ice (also Frostfin Isle colony), frost_caverns mine_deep (mine floors 31+), frost_glacier/falls/hearthhold all mega_frost, wind_breezehaven/sunrise/starfall all mega_wind.
fix: Give frost_summit/frost_caverns/hollow_deeps/sky_reaches their own 'music' (with music_fallback to the current one) so they light up when ACE renders land; list the ids in AUDIO-PLAN.
audio_needed: frost_summit, frost_caverns, hollow_deeps, sky_reaches songs (or variant takes)

title: Seasonal variants exist only on the farm: town, meadow, forest, lake etc play their spring/summer song in winter (and on snow days nothing changes)
repro: Probe: winter day town=town, meadow=meadow, forest=forest; only farm -> winter. is_wet() ignores snow, so snow days play the normal day song.
fix: Cheap: in winter on snow/blizzard days NIGHT_OK maps use 'winter'. Better: winter takes for town/meadow (audio_needed).

title: Interior picks: mansion plays the chapel organ; town hall plays the inn tavern song; lighthouse/water mill/fishing hut and all villager huts play your own farmhouse 'house' song
fix: mansion -> 'shop' or a quiet 'house'; hall -> 'town' (keeps the plaza song going without a restart); consider cottages -> 'town' so popping into a neighbour keeps the town song instead of switching to your own home theme.

title: Penguin finale: song ping-pongs between Fennimore's 'finargle' theme and the Dark Crystal's song every time the nearer boss changes
repro: p5_spire spawns dark_crystal (22,14) and finargle_elder (19,16, has gift b_elder so DangerMusic.is_boss is true). DangerMusic.assess picks the NEAREST boss each CHECK; boss_track_for gives finargle_elder PER_BOSS 'finargle' and dark_crystal its dm_track ('boss' from the story fx, or boss_penguin). tick: 'w == 4 and track differs -> a different boss stepped in' swaps and restarts the song as you move between them (3 tiles apart). 'finargle' is also missing from GameMap.BOSS_TRACKS, so the take-back branch re-plays it. CONFIRMED by probe tools/probe_c6_01_finale.gd (worktree c6_01, moon, both story spawns, boss_card + story 'boss'): 13 song swaps boss<->finargle in 24 s of game time while standing near one boss then the other (and even while standing still, as the bosses chase).
fix: In assess, once tier 4 is held keep the current boss while it is alive and engaged (sticky boss: only switch when the held boss dies or leaves BOSS_R*1.5); give the story-carded boss (boss_name meta / boss_card kind) priority over other bosses. Add 'finargle' to GameMap.BOSS_TRACKS. Extend tools/danger_music_test.gd with two bosses at different distances.

title: The merkitty vocal lullaby (merkitty_song, D8) is rendered and streamed but never played; the p4_merkitties beat ('the merkitties swim a circle around you, singing') has only an sfx
repro: grep: merkitty_song appears only in Music.ONCE/_standin and music_stream.json. Story penguins ch4 beat p4_merkitties effects = flags/items/companion/toast/hint/sfx/fx, no music. Pool merkitties on the farm 'sing at night' (farm.gd:175) silently.
fix: Add "music": "merkitty_song" to p4_merkitties effects (and Music.queue_after(area_track) so the lake song returns: a ONCE track with no _after leaves silence because DangerMusic.tick returns early while _current is in ONCE). Optional: play it softly near the Merkitty Pool at night.

title: Fennimore's 'finargle' theme (D6, 'finargle prison and lair') never plays at the crystal prison (p4_prison, sky)
repro: p4_prison effects: flags, scene_to, hint. The prison scene keeps the 'sky' song; 'finargle' is only reached as PER_BOSS for finargle_elder in the finale.
fix: Add "music": "finargle" to the p4_prison beat (it plays during the dialogue; DangerMusic re-asks area_track 3 s after, so pair with the story-music hold from the 'meadow 3 s' finding, or play it in the prison scene's area_track while flag prison_done is unset).

title: title_musicbox (F5: save screen and character creator) is never played
repro: grep title_musicbox: only music_map_test's situation list and music_stream.json. title.gd plays 'title' and arc_<arc>.
fix: Play title_musicbox when the save-slot list / creator opens in title.gd (back to 'title' on return to the main title).

title: Area songs restart from bar 1 after every interior visit (farm<->house, town<->shop) instead of resuming
repro: Music.play(track) -> _start sets a fresh stream and _player.play() from 0; no per-track position kept. Town -> store (shop) -> town restarts the town song; farm (night) -> house -> farm restarts 'night'.
fix: Keep a small {track: position} map in Music for looping area songs (save get_playback_position() of the outgoing player in _start); when the same track is asked for again within ~2 minutes, play(from_pos). Skip ONCE and boss tracks.
